how_to_apply: Visit the official DERC website at https://www.derc.gov.in.
Navigate to the openings or recruitment section and access the online application portal via https://www.derc.gov.in/app/home/openings.
Register or login to complete the application form for the desired deputation position.
Fill in all required educational, personal, and professional service details carefully.
Upload necessary documents and certificates as specified in the recruitment guidelines.
Submit the application online before the final closing date of 26 October 2026.
Note down any confirmation details or print a copy of the final submitted application for reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DERC Recruitment 2026 is an official recruitment notification issued by the Delhi Electricity Regulatory Commission to fill 18 key leadership and administrative positions on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 18 vacancies are available across various posts including Secretary, Executive Directors, Joint Directors, Deputy Directors, Assistant Directors, Assistant Account Officer, and Personnel Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for DERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission of applications is 26-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of recruitment for DERC posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment for all listed positions is conducted strictly on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for Executive Director posts in DERC?
faq.answer: The pay scale for Executive Director and Secretary posts is Level-14, ranging from Rs. 1,44,200 to Rs. 2,18,200.
